html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Heroes clad in steel armor and all kinds of weapons are approaching!

 

We introduce the September Update in celebration of the addition of the Invincible Iron Man Theme.

 

Stark Enterprises’ armor suit, Iron Man, War Machine, Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44), and Rescue, which were created to make the world safer, have become even more powerful by receiving new Uniforms.

 

Among them, Tier-4 Advancement has been added to support War Machine,

who protects the country from domestic and international threats,

and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44), a giant combat machine with incredible strength and durability.

 

Proxima Midnight and Corvus Glaive will face off against Agents as they appeared as the

new World Boss on the Legend+ difficulty.

 

In addition, the addition of the new C.T.P., the change of Future Pass, and various other improvements have been made to make the game more convenient to enjoy.

 

Please check the details below!

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

Four new Uniforms have been added in celebration of the Invincible Iron Man-themed Update.

Check out the abilities of Iron Man <Model Nil>, Hulkbuster <Thorbuster>, 

War Machine <Invincible Iron Man>, and Rescue <Invincible Iron Man>.

* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.

(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)

* The four new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <September Update Celebration Event>,

and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ War Machine & Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancement has been added to War Machine and Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44) with powerful firepower including various weapons and superhuman strength.

* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Wiccan and Hulkling Potential Awakening & Transcendence

 

Through the September Update, Wiccan and Hulkling

will acquire Potential Awakening & Transcendence!

* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ New World Boss: Legend+ <Corvus & Proxima> Release

& World Boss Improvements

 

Corvus Glaive & Proxima Midnight, members of the Black Order and notorious for their ruthlessness, 

have appeared as the second boss on World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

 

▶ World Boss: Legend+ <Corvus & Proxima> Release

 

1. Agents can challenge Corvus & Proxima from Difficulty 1 after clearing the unlock Challenges.

- Unlock Requirements:

Clear Story stage 8-3, Own three or more Tier-4 heroes, Clear all World Boss Challenges

- World Boss stages above every 10 levels are locked with specified Challenges, including those involving specific heroes.

 

 

 

2. Corvus & Proxima’s Conquer Level can be achieved up to 200, and the conquer effect can be upgraded

along with acquiring Odin's Blessing Chest, Dimension Chest: C.T.P, and Tier-3 growth materials.

- The basic damage Corvus & Proxima receive increases as the Conquer Level increases.

- The Conquer Effect that applies to Corvus & Proxima has been added to the Black Swan’s Conquer Effect depending on her Conquer level.

 

 

3. Agents will face two bosses, Corvus Glaive and Proxima Midnight in this stage for the first time in World Boss.

Overcome the cooperative patterns of the two bosses and earn rewards!

 

 

​- Depending on the progress, bosses will launch a powerful attack.

 

4. Clear Corvus & Proxima to acquire various rewards.

​- The Mighty C.T.P. of Energy, Regeneration, Destruction, Judgment, Authority, Greed, Refinement, and Insight can be acquired when clearing Corvus & Proxima.

- Cosmic Cube Fragments can be acquired at a 100% rate from the World Boss: Legend+ difficulty.

- Agents can obtain a 'Special World Boss Loot' as the first clear reward when clearing each Floor from the 10th Floor and above.

- Agents can obtain the Emblem: Corvus Glaive or Emblem: Proxima Midnight as the first clear reward for every 10 Floors from the 50th Floor and above.

 

 

 

▣ New C.T.P. & Reforging

 

The ‘C.T.P. of Liberation’ has been added as a new Custom Gear.

When reforging, effects that increase survivability or damage will be added.

* The options are based on the maximum stats.

* One of the two reforge options will be selected randomly based on the chances.

* The C.T.P. of Liberation can be acquired from the [Store] - [Dimension Chest] - [Custom Gear Chest] menu after the September Update.

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Hulkbuster (Iron Man Mark 44), War Machine, Rescue, Wiccan, and Hulkling will be added after the September Update.

* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ Future Pass Change & New Future Pass Season & Special Icons

 

The Future Pass will be remodeled as the ‘Future Pass Plus’ after the 9/3 Update.

 

The name of the product and the list of rewards have been changed.

The prices of the products are as follows:

Future Pass Plus - Legendary: $9.99

Future Pass Plus - Mythic: $19.99

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season 

the Pass was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.

- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.

- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase

when the season is about to end. Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 

one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[September Update New Special Icon]

 

 

  

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection & Improvements

 

1. Check out the new Uniforms of the Invincible Iron Man theme.

Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

2. The latest Uniform Collection is now displayed at the top.

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. A filter function has been added to the [Marvel Universe] - [Artifact] menu.

A search bar and effect filter have been added to the Artifact List

- The Applied Target filter, Effect filter, and search bar have been added.

- You can search by entering the hero name and Artifact name.

 

 

2. Improvements have been made in the Dispatch Shop.

- The list and the price of products have been changed.

- The Chance product and the Discount product have been added.

* The Chance products appear depending on the Dispatch Shop Level and a set probability.

* The Discount products appear depending on a set probability.

 

 

3. ‘Update Hot Deals’ products have been added.

- Event Schedule:

After the 9/3 Maintenance - 10/1 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),

After the 9/3 Maintenance - 10/1 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- The following products are available in the ‘Update Hot Deals’ category in the Store.

* The price is based on the Google Play Store.

 

 

 

 

 

4. Checking reward information in Otherworld Battle has become more convenient.

- A border appears around the reward information of the rank you achieved in the [My League Info].

- League Rewards are now sorted in descending order like Rank Rewards in the [My League Info] > [Reward] tab.

 

5. The Achievement for linking an email account has been added.

- Agents can get 200 Crystals when linking their email accounts.

- Agents who linked their email accounts before the maintenance can also receive rewards.

* The Facebook account linking will end soon.

We strongly recommend you link the Email or market account.

 

6. Components of certain products have been changed.

Please check the link below for more details.

[Advance Notice on the Change of Products]

 

7. The MARVEL Future Fight Web Shop mentioned in the Update Livestream will be introduced through a separate notice later.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. The Set Team button is available for heroes who do not meet the participation requirements in the [Team Bonus Per Character] and [All] of World Boss Legend+ has been fixed.

 

2. The skill displayed as a Tier-2 Passive Skill on the screen when upgrading a hero to Tier-3 has been fixed.

 

3. The screen moves to Whiplash's Biometrics purchase screen when clicking the [Support Shop] button by selecting the magnifier icon of the Biometrics on the Character Level Up screen has been fixed.

 

4. [Change Comic Card Options] mission of 6★ Comic Cards is displayed as [Combine Comic Card Options] in the Agent Welcome Back Training has been fixed.

 

5. Team ATK is not applied normally in the Select Character Screen of World Boss when the Comic Card Deck was set as Card Deck 2 has been fixed.

 

[9/3 (Tue) 9:30 (UTC+0), 9/3 (Tue) 2:30 (PDT) added]

6. The Counterattack effect of Doctor Doom <God Emperor>’s Active 2 Skill does not work occasionally after resurrection has been fixed. 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.
